trials.activation_trigger: A real cross-repository edge requires contract binding plus independent non-origin consumer proof and cannot be cleanly owned by U04 alone.
trials.mission_or_task_scope: One bounded cross-repo integration edge only.
trials.success_condition: Two distinct bounded integration edges complete with accepted independent-consumer evidence and no authority collision.
trials.failure_condition: Work is adequately handled by U04/U06 secondment, or trial repeatedly creates duplicated authority/rework.
trials.return_or_merge_rule: Merge competencies into U04/U06 if recurrence/independence does not justify a permanent cell.

trials.activation_trigger: A mission explicitly requires origin/build separation from verification, beyond ordinary U06 QA attestation.
trials.mission_or_task_scope: One bounded non-origin verification chain only.
trials.success_condition: Two distinct verification chains demonstrate material independence value, including at least one challenge that ordinary origin-side checks could not supply.
trials.failure_condition: U06 QA already provides sufficient independence or trial adds latency without changing disposition quality.
trials.return_or_merge_rule: Merge verification competencies into U06 if separate independence is not recurrently necessary.
